Recurring membership

Monthly and annual members can use secure account-bound billing tools to manage payment methods, view billing information and cancel future renewals.

Charter Membership

The prepaid 36-month term does not automatically renew. Franklin Navigator is designed to provide 60-, 30- and 7-day expiration reminders and require a fresh affirmative renewal choice.

Payment problems, cancellation and refunds

Payment failure, recovery, cancellation, refund and membership access must stay accurate and consistent. New public checkout remains closed while Franklin completes the remaining launch checks. Existing active members can use their account-bound billing controls.

Language and accessibility

Support may be requested in English or Spanish. Tell us about an accessibility barrier at community@franklinnavigator.com.

Before new checkout opens: Franklin must complete the remaining launch checks for terms, support, cancellation/refund handling, billing synchronization and first-value fulfillment. Existing members should not make another payment for an active membership.
